methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The article establish accounting frameworks of energy performance index(EPI) based on Logarithmic Mean Divisia Index(LMDI) decomposition technology which considering the activity effect, structure effect, intensity effect of energy consumption

paper_type.evidence_quote: Then analyze the energy consumption of Beijing during 2000 to 2008 by the accounting frameworks.

level_3b.evidence_quote: The total amount of the energy consumption can be divided into three parts: the primary industry accounts for 1.55%

stage1.notes: EPI/LMDI index decomposition applied economy-wide to Beijing (2000-2008), not an organisation/site. Eligibility & paper_type borderline (macro scope); level_3b false (no closed-list sector).

country_region.evidence_quote: The total amount of Beijing's energy consumption is increasing

type_of_organisation.evidence_quote: the primary industry accounts for 1.55%, decreased by 1 % compared with that of 2000;the secondary industry accounts for 39.7%, decreased compared with 58.8% in 2000; and the tertiary industry accounts for 41.1 %

enpi_enb_model_types.evidence_quote: energy performance index(EPI) based on Logarithmic Mean Divisia Index(LMDI) decomposition technology
